result.name: Insert Product
result.description: Add a product to an API data source of the connected Merchant Center account. If the data source already has an entry with the same product_id, content_language and feed_label, the new entry replaces it. data_source is the data_source_id or data_source_name of an API data source (Data Sources table, or create one with create_data_source). In a primary data source, give the attributes that Google needs to show the product, for example title, link, image_link, price, currency and availability. Merchant Center shows the change after a few minutes. Remove the product with delete_product.

additional_image_links.description: URLs of up to 10 more images of the product. Use stable URLs, as for image_link.
additional_image_links.title: Additional Image Links

data_source.description: data_source_id or data_source_name of an API data source.
data_source.title: Data Source

image_link.description: URL of the main image of the product. Use a stable URL, without parameters that change, such as timestamps or session IDs: Google fetches the image from it again.
image_link.title: Image Link

product_id.description: The offer id of the product.
product_id.title: Product Id

result.name: Update Product
result.description: Change the given attributes of a product in an API data source of the connected Merchant Center account. Attributes that are not given keep their values. product_id, content_language and feed_label come from the product_id, product_content_language and product_feed_label fields. data_source is the data_source_id or data_source_name of an API data source: the product's primary data source (product_data_source) if its input is API, otherwise a supplemental API data source that is linked to that primary data source (create one with create_data_source and link_to_primary_data_source). Values of a supplemental data source that comes before the feed in the feed's default rule (as create_data_source links it) override the feed values until delete_product removes them from the supplemental data source. clear_attributes deletes attributes from the product in data_source: in a supplemental data source the product then shows the feed value again. pause ADS or ALL pauses the product, NONE ends the pause. Merchant Center shows the change after a few minutes.

additional_image_links.description: URLs of up to 10 more images of the product. Use stable URLs, as for image_link.
additional_image_links.title: Additional Image Links

result.name: Delete Product
result.description: Delete a product from an API data source of the connected Merchant Center account. From a primary data source this removes the whole product, including its supplemental values: only insert_product with all attributes adds it again. From a supplemental data source this removes only the values of that data source, and the product keeps its primary values. data_source is the data_source_id or data_source_name of the API data source.

result.name: Create Data Source
result.description: Create an API product data source in the connected Merchant Center account. A primary data source holds products that insert_product adds. A supplemental data source holds values that update_product writes for products from a file feed, an app or the Merchant Center UI. Merchant Center applies them only to products of the primary data sources that the supplemental data source is linked to. link_to_primary_data_source (data_source_id or data_source_name) puts the new supplemental data source first in the default rule of that primary data source, so its values override the feed, and keeps the sources the rule already uses. The user removes the link in Merchant Center (the Attribute rules of the primary data source). Give content_language and feed_label together to accept only products with them, or leave both out to accept every product. countries is for a primary data source only. Each call creates a new data source: list the existing ones in the Data Sources table first.
